author: Eternalll
name: Servertag
description: Look up the server tag a user has equipped, or list every member of the server wearing a given tag.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users.
install_msg: Thanks for installing! Use `[p]getservertag` to look up a user, or `[p]servertag <tag>` to list members wearing a tag.
